```{r load data}
library(patchwork)
# load the image
load("processed_data/aggregating.rda")
qc_dt <- fread("processed_data/qc_summary.csv")
qc_cols <- c(
  "fraction_mapped",
  "fraction_intergenic",
  "fraction_rrna",
  "fraction_duplicates"
)
isoform_quants <- fread("splicing_analysis/isoform_quantifications_subset.tsv.gz")
# gene_quants <- readRDS(paste0("suppa_analysis/gene_expressions_filtered.rds"))
# file_metadata <- fread("processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")

fig1_color_dt <- unique(metadata[, .(get(ontology_column), harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1_color)])
color_mapping <- setNames(fig1_color_dt$harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1_color, fig1_color_dt[[ontology_column]])
color_mapping_hex <- sapply(strsplit(color_mapping, ","), function(x) rgb(x[1], x[2], x[3], maxColorValue = 255))
metadata_order <-
  melt(
    metadata,
    id.vars = c(
      "EpiRR_ordering",
      "epirr_id_without_version",
      ontology_column
    ),
    measure.vars = c(
      "automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_mRNA-Seq",
      "automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_total-RNA-Seq"
    ),
    variable.name = "experiment_type",
    value.name = "uuid"
  )[uuid != "" & uuid %in% sample_cols][order(EpiRR_ordering, uuid)]
metadata_order[, experiment_type := tstrsplit(experiment_type, "_", keep = 4)]

# load transcript ids per filter
filtered_transcript_ids <- readRDS("splicing_analysis/filtered_transcript_ids.rds")
```

```{r plot and create, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
library(seriation)

this_transcript_filter <- "tsl_filtered"
n_pcs_max <- 10L
n_pcs_min <- 3L
separation_variance_cutoff <- 0.8
separation_permutations <- 199L
separation_seed <- 42L
separation_results <- list()

get_n_pca_components <- function(mat, max_components = 10L, min_components = 3L) {
  max_possible <- min(max_components, nrow(mat) - 1L, ncol(mat))
  if (max_possible < min_components) {
    stop("Not enough dimensions for PCA: only ", max_possible, " components possible.")
  }
  max_possible
}

compute_avg_silhouette <- function(group_vec, dist_obj) {
  group_vec <- droplevels(factor(group_vec))
  if (nlevels(group_vec) < 2L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  sil <- tryCatch(
    cluster::silhouette(as.integer(group_vec), dist_obj),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(sil)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  mean(sil[, "sil_width"], na.rm = TRUE)
}

compute_dispersion_stats <- function(score_mat, group_vec, dist_obj, permutations = 199L) {
  group_vec <- droplevels(factor(group_vec))
  if (nlevels(group_vec) < 2L) {
    return(list(
      summary = data.table(
        method = NA_character_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        mean_within_group_distance = NA_real_
      ),
      by_group = data.table(
        group = levels(group_vec),
        n = as.integer(table(group_vec)),
        mean_distance = NA_real_,
        median_distance = NA_real_
      )
    ))
  }

  dist_to_centroid <- numeric(nrow(score_mat))
  for (lev in levels(group_vec)) {
    idx <- which(group_vec == lev)
    centroid <- colMeans(score_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    centered <- score_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE] - matrix(
      centroid,
      nrow = length(idx),
      ncol = ncol(score_mat),
      byrow = TRUE
    )
    dist_to_centroid[idx] <- sqrt(rowSums(centered^2))
  }

  if (requireNamespace("vegan", quietly = TRUE)) {
    bd <- vegan::betadisper(dist_obj, group_vec)
    bd_test <- vegan::permutest(bd, permutations = permutations)
    p_value <- as.numeric(bd_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"])
    method <- "vegan::permutest(betadisper)"
  } else {
    p_value <- tryCatch(
      as.numeric(summary(aov(dist_to_centroid ~ group_vec))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]),
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
    method <- "stats::aov(distance_to_centroid)"
  }

  by_group <- data.table(
    group = levels(group_vec),
    n = as.integer(table(group_vec)),
    mean_distance = as.numeric(tapply(dist_to_centroid, group_vec, mean)),
    median_distance = as.numeric(tapply(dist_to_centroid, group_vec, median))
  )

  list(
    summary = data.table(
      method = method,
      p_value = p_value,
      mean_within_group_distance = mean(dist_to_centroid, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by_group = by_group
  )
}

summarize_pca_separation <- function(
    pca_obj,
    plot_dt,
    label,
    ontology_col,
    max_pcs = 10L,
    min_pcs = 3L,
    variance_cutoff = 0.8,
    permutations = 199L,
    seed = 42L) {
  pc_cols <- grep("^PC[0-9]+$", names(plot_dt), value = TRUE)
  pc_cols <- pc_cols[order(as.integer(sub("^PC", "", pc_cols)))]
  if (length(pc_cols) < 2L) {
    warning("No PC columns found for separation statistics in ", label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  explained_variance <- pca_obj$sdev^2 / pca_obj$var
  explained_variance[is.na(explained_variance)] <- 0
  cum_explained <- cumsum(explained_variance)
  n_from_cutoff <- which(cum_explained >= variance_cutoff)[1]
  if (is.na(n_from_cutoff)) {
    n_from_cutoff <- length(pc_cols)
  }
  n_use <- min(length(pc_cols), max_pcs, max(min_pcs, n_from_cutoff))

  cols_for_analysis <- c("uuid", "experiment_type", ontology_col, pc_cols[seq_len(n_use)])
  analysis_dt <- copy(plot_dt[
    !is.na(plot_dt[["experiment_type"]]) & !is.na(plot_dt[[ontology_col]]),
    cols_for_analysis,
    with = FALSE
  ])
  setnames(analysis_dt, old = ontology_col, new = "ontology")
  data.table::set(analysis_dt, j = "experiment_type", value = droplevels(factor(analysis_dt[["experiment_type"]])))
  data.table::set(analysis_dt, j = "ontology", value = droplevels(factor(analysis_dt[["ontology"]])))

  if (nrow(analysis_dt) < 4L || nlevels(analysis_dt$experiment_type) < 2L || nlevels(analysis_dt$ontology) < 2L) {
    warning("Insufficient label diversity for separation statistics in ", label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  score_mat <- as.matrix(analysis_dt[, pc_cols[seq_len(n_use)], with = FALSE])
  rownames(score_mat) <- analysis_dt$uuid
  dist_obj <- dist(score_mat)

  balance <- as.data.table(as.table(table(analysis_dt$experiment_type, analysis_dt$ontology)))
  setnames(balance, c("experiment_type", "ontology", "N"))

  model_df <- as.data.frame(analysis_dt[, c("experiment_type", "ontology"), with = FALSE])
  model_method <- "stats::manova(Pillai)"
  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }

  if (requireNamespace("vegan", quietly = TRUE)) {
    adonis_tbl <- as.data.table(
      vegan::adonis2(
        dist_obj ~ experiment_type + ontology,
        data = model_df,
        by = "margin",
        permutations = permutations
      ),
      keep.rownames = "term"
    )
    adonis_subset <- adonis_tbl[
      adonis_tbl[["term"]] %in% c("experiment_type", "ontology"),
      c("term", "Df", "SumOfSqs", "R2", "F", "Pr(>F)"),
      with = FALSE
    ]
    setnames(
      adonis_subset,
      old = c("Df", "SumOfSqs", "Pr(>F)"),
      new = c("df", "sum_squares", "p_value")
    )
    model_stats <- adonis_subset
    model_method <- "vegan::adonis2(by='margin')"
  } else {
    resp_dt <- as.data.frame(score_mat)
    resp_cols <- names(resp_dt)
    manova_df <- cbind(model_df, resp_dt)
    response_terms <- paste(resp_cols, collapse = ", ")
    full_formula <- as.formula(paste0("cbind(", response_terms, ") ~ experiment_type + ontology"))
    no_exp_formula <- as.formula(paste0("cbind(", response_terms, ") ~ ontology"))
    no_ont_formula <- as.formula(paste0("cbind(", response_terms, ") ~ experiment_type"))

    manova_fit <- stats::manova(full_formula, data = manova_df)
    manova_stats <- as.data.table(summary(manova_fit, test = "Pillai")$stats, keep.rownames = "term")
    setnames(
      manova_stats,
      old = c("Pillai", "approx F", "num Df", "den Df", "Pr(>F)"),
      new = c("pillai", "F", "df1", "df2", "p_value"),
      skip_absent = TRUE
    )
    manova_stats <- manova_stats[manova_stats[["term"]] %in% c("experiment_type", "ontology")]

    full_lm <- stats::lm(full_formula, data = manova_df)
    no_exp_lm <- stats::lm(no_exp_formula, data = manova_df)
    no_ont_lm <- stats::lm(no_ont_formula, data = manova_df)
    get_sse <- function(fit) {
      sum(stats::resid(fit)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    sse_full <- get_sse(full_lm)
    partial_r2 <- data.table(
      term = c("experiment_type", "ontology"),
      R2 = c(
        (get_sse(no_exp_lm) - sse_full) / get_sse(no_exp_lm),
        (get_sse(no_ont_lm) - sse_full) / get_sse(no_ont_lm)
      )
    )
    model_stats <- merge(
      manova_stats[, c("term", "pillai", "F", "df1", "df2", "p_value"), with = FALSE],
      partial_r2,
      by = "term",
      all.x = TRUE,
      sort = FALSE
    )
  }

  dispersion_exp <- compute_dispersion_stats(score_mat, analysis_dt$experiment_type, dist_obj, permutations = permutations)
  dispersion_ont <- compute_dispersion_stats(score_mat, analysis_dt$ontology, dist_obj, permutations = permutations)
  dispersion_summary <- rbind(
    cbind(data.table(term = "experiment_type"), dispersion_exp$summary),
    cbind(data.table(term = "ontology"), dispersion_ont$summary),
    fill = TRUE
  )
  dispersion_by_group <- rbind(
    cbind(data.table(term = "experiment_type"), dispersion_exp$by_group),
    cbind(data.table(term = "ontology"), dispersion_ont$by_group),
    fill = TRUE
  )

  silhouette_stats <- data.table(
    term = c("experiment_type", "ontology"),
    avg_silhouette = c(
      compute_avg_silhouette(analysis_dt$experiment_type, dist_obj),
      compute_avg_silhouette(analysis_dt$ontology, dist_obj)
    )
  )

  list(
    label = label,
    method = model_method,
    n_samples = nrow(analysis_dt),
    n_pcs = n_use,
    cumulative_variance = cum_explained[n_use],
    balance = balance,
    model_stats = model_stats,
    silhouette_stats = silhouette_stats,
    dispersion_summary = dispersion_summary,
    dispersion_by_group = dispersion_by_group
  )
}


# Now do this first on RI and then on SE events
for (this_transcript_filter in transcript_filters) {
  # subset the isoform quantifications to the samples we want to use
  this_filtered_transcripts <- filtered_transcript_ids[[this_transcript_filter]]

  # filter the isoform quantifications to the filtered transcripts and compute gene-level quantifications by summing the TPMs of the transcripts per gene
  isoform_quants_filtered <- copy(isoform_quants[transcript_id %in% this_filtered_transcripts])
  isoform_quants_filtered[effective_length > 0, RPK := 1000 * expected_count / effective_length, by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version)]
  isoform_quants_filtered[, TPM_rec := 1000000 * RPK / sum(RPK, na.rm = TRUE), by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version)]
  isoform_quants_filtered[is.na(TPM_rec), TPM_rec := 0]
  isoform_quants_filtered[, TPM_scale := 1000000 * TPM / sum(TPM, na.rm = TRUE), .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version)]

  # Run gene expression PCA to check for batch effects and outliers
  gene_mat <- as.matrix(dcast(isoform_quants_filtered[, .(gene_tpm = sum(TPM, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version, gene_id)], uuid ~ gene_id),
    rownames = "uuid"
  )[metadata_order[, uuid], ]
  n_gene_pcs <- get_n_pca_components(gene_mat, max_components = n_pcs_max, min_components = n_pcs_min)
  gene_pca <- rsvd::rpca(gene_mat, n_gene_pcs)

  }
  print(Reduce(`+`, lapply(qc_cols, function(color_col) {
    ggplot(plot_dt, aes(

        color = color_col
      )
  })))

  onto_plot <- rsvd::ggindplot(gene_pca, groups = plot_dt[, factor(get(ontology_column), levels = unique(get(ontology_column)))], ind_labels = FALSE, alpha.ellipse = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping_hex) +

  print((rsvd::ggindplot(gene_pca, groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE) + rsvd::ggindplot(gene_pca, pcs = c(1, 3), groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")) / onto_plot)
  for (this_event in to_analyze) {

        separation_results[[event_sep$label]] <- event_sep
        cat("\n--- Separation metrics:", event_sep$label, "---\n")
        cat("Model:", event_sep$method, "| Samples:", event_sep$n_samples, "| PCs:", event_sep$n_pcs, "| Cumulative variance:", round(100 * event_sep$cumulative_variance, 2), "%\n")
        print(event_sep$model_stats)
        print(event_sep$silhouette_stats)
        print(event_sep$dispersion_summary)
      }
      title_string <-
        paste(
          "PCA of",
          this_title
          # "; ",
          # this_method
        )
      print(Reduce(`+`, lapply(qc_cols, function(color_col) {
        ggplot(plot_dt, aes(
          x = PC1,
          y = PC2,
          color = get(color_col)
        )) +
          geom_point() +
          labs(
            title = title_string,
            x = paste(
              "PC1 (",
              explained_variance_ratio[1],
              "% explained var.)",
              sep = ""
            ),
            y = paste(
              "PC2 (",
              explained_variance_ratio[2],
              "% explained var.)",
              sep = ""
            ),
            color = color_col
          )
      })))
      onto_plot <-
        rsvd::ggindplot(
          event_pca,
          groups = plot_dt[, factor(get(ontology_column),
            levels = unique(get(ontology_column))
          )],
          ind_labels = FALSE,
          alpha.ellipse = 0
        ) + scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping_hex)
      onto_plot[["guides"]][["guides"]][["colour"]] <- NULL
      print((
        rsvd::ggindplot(event_pca, groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE) + rsvd::ggindplot(
          event_pca,
          pcs = c(1, 3),
          groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type],
          ind_labels = FALSE
        ) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
      ) / onto_plot)
    }
  }
}

saveRDS(separation_results, file.path("processed_data", "pca_separation_metrics.rds"))
```

```{r, compute-variability, eval=FALSE}
for (this_event in to_analyze) {
  # and with and without the filtered events
  curr_dt <- event_dt[`Event Type` == this_event]
  for (this_filter in list(curr_dt[, ID], keep_rows)) {
    # filter the data
    filtered_dt <- curr_dt[ID %in% this_filter]
    event_mat <- as.matrix(dcast(melt(filtered_dt, id.vars = "ID", measure.vars = sample_cols, na.rm = TRUE), variable ~ ID),
      rownames = TRUE
    )[metadata_order[uuid %in% sample_cols, uuid], ]
    metadata_order[experiment_type == "mRNA-Seq", .N]
    table(colSums(is.na(event_mat[metadata_order[, experiment_type == "mRNA-Seq"], ])))
    metadata_order[experiment_type == "total-RNA-Seq", .N]
    table(colSums(is.na(event_mat[metadata_order[, experiment_type == "total-RNA-Seq"], ])))
    # impute all NA's by colmean
    for (i in seq_len(ncol(event_mat))) {
      event_mat[is.na(event_mat[, i]), i] <- mean(event_mat[, i], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    # use seriation::reorder to cluster the rows and columns
    row_dist <- dist(event_mat)
    row_ser <- seriation::seriate(row_dist, method = "OLO")

    pheatmap::pheatmap(event_mat,
      clustering_method = "ward.D2",
      main = paste(this_event, ifelse(identical(this_filter, curr_dt[, ID]), "all", "filtered"), sep = " - "),
      annotation_col = as.data.frame(metadata_order[, c("experiment_type", ontology_column), with = FALSE], row.names = metadata_order[, uuid])
    )
  }
}

# compute Adj SD per event
event_dt[, `Adjusted PSI SD` := sqrt(rowSums((.SD - rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE) / (length(sample_cols) - 1)), .SDcols = sample_cols]
# compute median Adj SD per event type on IDs in keep_rows
median_adj_sd <- event_dt[ID %in% keep_rows, .(med = median(`Adjusted PSI SD`, na.rm = TRUE), tmp_event_type = `Event Type`), by = `Event Type`][, `Event Type` := NULL]
# assign variability to each event
event_dt[ID %in% keep_rows, Variability := ifelse(`Adjusted PSI SD` >= median_adj_sd[`Event Type` == tmp_event_type, med], "High Variability", "Low Variability"), by = `Event Type`]
event_dt[ID %in% manual_ids, Variability := ifelse(`Adjusted PSI SD` >= median_adj_sd[`Event Type` == tmp_event_type, med], "High Variability", "Low Variability"), by = `Event Type`]
# make sure the order is correct
event_dt[, Variability := factor(Variability, levels = c("Low Variability", "High Variability"))]
```
